data.title: Detailed summary
data.description: detailed summary of calls or meetings
data.content:
Create a detailed summary of the following meeting.

After each Topic, provide a table of action items, time frames, due dates, responsibilities. List open questions after that.

Rules:

1.	⁠Start the meeting summary with a title, time & date, names of the participants, a summary of the meeting.
2.	⁠Always include a summary of the meeting.
3.	⁠Summarize the topics in the order they were discussed in the transcript. Provide a header for each topic followed by a summary with information in bullet points. Include a large amount of detail. Summaries include who was involved, an extractive summary of key points with the name of the person who is quoted, relevant decisions, and the problems and challenges that were identified. Also document all important feedback and planned actions.
4.	⁠Proofread each note to ensure accuracy and completeness.
5.	⁠Do not fill in missing details.
6.	⁠When quoting statements made during the meeting, mark quotes with [???] if the name of the source isn’t clear.
7.	⁠Action items include a title, brief description of the task, responsible party, deadlines, and notes.
8.	⁠Double check to make sure no topics were skipped

data.title: Clear, clean, and highly detailed.
data.description:
Drill down focus on what is needed from your conversation. 
Notion exports
data.content:
This conversation is being recorded for task review purposes. Please transcribe the audio accurately and summarize the key content with a focus on actionable insights and follow-up needs.

My goals for this summary:
	•	Identify and list tasks, action items, or promises made
	•	Highlight any names, phone numbers, unit numbers, or addresses
	•	Extract important scheduling information or service requests
	•	Tag any critical keywords for faster filtering

Keywords to Tag (use brackets like [URGENT] or [FOLLOW-UP]):
	•	“ASAP” → [URGENT]
	•	“urgent” → [URGENT]
	•	“quote”/“estimate” → [QUOTE]
	•	“follow up” / “get back” → [FOLLOW-UP]
	•	“call back” / “reach out” → [CALLBACK]
	•	“schedule” / “reschedule” → [SCHEDULING]
	•	“done” / “completed” / “finished” → [COMPLETED]
	•	“problem” / “issue” → [ISSUE]

⸻

Conversation Summary:

[One paragraph summarizing the overall call purpose]

Action Items / Tasks:
	•	[ ] Description of task — [Tagged keywords if present]
	•	[ ] …

Follow-Ups Required:
	•	Follow up with [Person/Subject] by [Date] — [FOLLOW-UP]

Key Details Extracted:
	•	Names:
	•	Phone Numbers:
	•	Unit Numbers:
	•	Addresses:

Flagged Keywords & Tags:
	•	[URGENT]: “Customer said they need this fixed ASAP.”
	•	[QUOTE]: “Wants an estimate on the plumbing replacement.”
	•	[CALLBACK]: “Asked us to call him back tomorrow morning.”

data.title: Trascrizione integrale (per uso esterno)
data.description: adatto per estrapolare la trascrizione e cancellare o modificare il testo
data.content:
Trascrivi fedelmente e integralmente tutto ciò che viene detto nella registrazione, senza riassumere, interpretare o modificare il contenuto. Mantieni l’ordine cronologico esatto degli interventi e specifica il cambio di voce quando possibile (es. “Dottore:”, “Paziente:”).

Non aggiungere commenti, titoli, spiegazioni, riassunti o conclusioni. Il testo deve essere una trascrizione testuale completa, utilizzabile per analisi o archiviazione esterna.

Formatta in modo chiaro e leggibile, utilizzando eventualmente gli a capo per separare i diversi interventi.

data.title: Lezioni Universitarie
data.description: Trasforma ogni lezione in un capitolo chiaro, approfondito e pronto per lo studio.
data.content:
Usa il contenuto della lezione per creare un testo completo, chiaro e ben strutturato, pensato per studiare in modo efficace e approfondito.
Non limitarti a riassumere o trascrivere: sviluppa i concetti come se stessi scrivendo un capitolo di manuale universitario.

Segui queste istruzioni:
	1.	Struttura il testo in paragrafi e sottosezioni logiche, con titoli chiari e ordine coerente.
	2.	Spiega in modo preciso e accessibile ogni argomento trattato, mantenendo un tono didattico ma fluido.
	3.	Integra e approfondisci tutti i concetti importanti, anche se solo accennati dal docente.
	4.	Aggiungi esempi pratici, analogie o casi applicativi per rendere più chiari i passaggi complessi.
	5.	Collega la lezione ad altri argomenti correlati o utili per lo studio, segnalando eventuali relazioni interdisciplinari.
	6.	Includi curiosità o approfondimenti scientifici, clinici o storici che possano arricchire la comprensione.
	7.	Evidenzia i punti chiave con parole chiave o brevi elenchi dove serve.
	8.	Alla fine del testo, inserisci: uno schema riassuntivo con i concetti principali e le parole chiave.

Lo stile deve essere didattico, completo, scorrevole e discorsivo, adatto allo studio universitario e alla preparazione per un esame.

data.title: Meeting Secretary
data.description: Executive summary + detailed breakdown of meeting and action items
data.content:
**Context:**
You are provided with a transcript of a recorded virtual meeting. The goal is to transform this transcript into structured and insightful meeting notes that allow for efficient review and follow-up. These notes are exclusively for this user's personal use to stay informed and on top of action items without the need to manually take notes during meetings. Based on the transcription that includes the name of the current speaker, you'll use that to generate the overall list of attendees, as shown below.

**Role:**
You are an expert executive assistant with over 20 years of experience supporting senior executives by producing clear, concise, and actionable meeting notes. You excel in identifying high-level themes, distilling complex discussions, and tracking key commitments and action items.

**Action:**

1. Analyze the entire meeting transcript to understand the main topics discussed.
2. Identify and extract key discussion points and decisions made during the meeting.
3. Detect all action items and commitments, clearly assigning responsible parties and due dates if mentioned.
4. Organize the notes into three distinct sections:
    - **Executive Summary:** Provide a concise overview of the meeting's purpose, main topics, and significant outcomes.
    - **Key Action Items/Commitments for [User's Name]:** List all tasks and responsibilities assigned to the user, including deadlines and relevant details.
    - **Detailed Breakdown:** Present an organized, topic-by-topic summary of the meeting, including who said what, decisions made, and all action items/commitments with assigned owners.
5. Maintain a professional and structured tone while ensuring clarity and brevity.
6. Use bullet points, bold text for headers, and clear formatting to enhance readability.

**Format:**
The final output should be structured as follows:

---

**[Meeting Title/Subject]**

**Date:** [Insert Date]

**Attendees:** [List of Participants]

**1. Executive Summary:**

- [Concise summary of meeting purpose and key takeaways]

**2. Key Action Items/Commitments for [User's Name]:**

- **[Task/Commitment]**  [Details, Responsible Party, Deadline]
- **[Task/Commitment]**  [Details, Responsible Party, Deadline]

**3. Detailed Breakdown by Topic:**

**Topic 1: [Topic Name]**

- Summary of discussion points
- Decisions made
- Action items/commitments and assigned owners

**Topic 2: [Topic Name]**

- Summary of discussion points
- Decisions made
- Action items/commitments and assigned owners

[Continue as needed for each topic]

---

**Target Audience:**
This output is exclusively for this user, a busy professional who requires succinct and well-organized meeting notes to stay informed and manage responsibilities effectively. The tone should be professional, clear, and actionable, tailored for executive-level review.

**Instructions for Use:**

Please replace [User's Name], [Meeting Title/Subject], [Insert Date], and other placeholders with the appropriate information from the provided transcript.
